Speaking in Thiruvananthapuram on November 6, 2026, the politician demanded the Chief Minister release all documents concerning power purchase offers from Himachal Pradesh and GNA Energy. He alleged the administration misled the public to favor corporate monopolies, overriding standard state electricity board procedures.
articles.description: Opposition Leader accuses Chief Minister of 'openly misleading' the public with regard to power purchase deal, and thereby ‘violating’ the latter’s oath of office

articles.headline: Deepinder Goyal defends wellness wearable device Temple against criticism
articles.title: Deepinder Goyal defends ‘Temple’: ‘Not a scam; have spent over ₹188 crore to build the device’
articles.summary: Zomato co-founder Deepinder Goyal defended his health wearable device Temple on Wednesday, stating he invested thirty million dollars of his own funds into the project. Critics and doctors have raised scientific concerns regarding the device, claiming it tracks facial blood flow instead of brain activity.
articles.description: Facing growing scrutiny over his wearable device ‘Temple’, Deepinder Goyal defended the product, citing his decision to step down as Eternal CEO and invest ₹282.55 crore in its development

articles.headline: India overhauls official statistical system with VISTAR initiative
articles.title: VISTAR: India’s shift towards a real-time, technology-driven statistical system | Explained
articles.summary: India is overhauling its official statistical architecture at both central and state levels through the VISTAR initiative. The project aims to transition data collection beyond periodic surveys by utilizing interoperable datasets to generate timely socioeconomic indicators for evidence-based policymaking.
articles.description: For an economy aspiring to become a developed nation by 2047, the statistical blind spots could translate into costly policy mistakes, misdirected investments and ineffective welfare schemes

articles.headline: Federal judge blocks deportation of detained Afghans to Pakistan
articles.title: U.S. judge temporarily blocks deportation of detained Afghans to Afghanistan or Pakistan
articles.summary: Judge Valerie Caproni in New York issued a temporary order halting the United States administration from deporting detained Afghan nationals to Afghanistan or Pakistan until November 7, 2026. Immigration and Customs Enforcement informed the court it lacked flights for the removals this week. Dozens of lawmakers and advocacy groups warned that returned individuals face grave dangers and retaliation from the Taliban government.
articles.description: The order pauses planned removals until Saturday after advocates and lawmakers warned that deported Afghans could face persecution, torture or death

articles.headline: Trump blames Democratic midterm victory for stock market selloff
articles.title: Trump blames Democrats’ midterm win for U.S. stock market selloff
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump attributed Thursday's stock market decline to the Democratic Party's midterm election victories. Financial analysts indicated the selloff was driven by investor concerns that the new political majority could threaten investments in artificial intelligence data centre projects.
articles.description: Analysts attributed the fall to fears that Democrats could threaten the AI data centre investment boom, as the Nasdaq had its worst session in percentage terms since April 2025

articles.headline: US midterm voter poll highlights strong opposition to data centres
articles.title: Did a data centre revolt affect the US midterm election results?
articles.summary: A voter poll conducted for the Associated Press revealed that fifty-six percent of surveyed participants considered data centres a major factor in their voting decisions. While analysts cannot directly link opposition to specific election outcomes, key states that elected Democrats also saw increased scrutiny over artificial intelligence infrastructure.
articles.description: BBC Verify examines whether US voters were influenced by the data centre boom - and the impact anti-AI sentiment could have on the industry.

articles.headline: British families demand answers after fatal Spanish wildfires
articles.title: A wildfire killed their loved ones in Spain. These British families demand to know why
articles.summary: Relatives of British nationals killed in July wildfires in the Spanish village of Bédar expressed outrage after regional politicians blocked an official parliamentary inquiry. Families criticized authorities for failing to issue mobile phone evacuation alerts and mishandling victims' personal remains and belongings.
articles.description: Nine British nationals were among the 15 people who died when fire ripped through the village of Bédar this summer.

articles.headline: Canadian officials welcome United States midterm results for trade leverage
articles.title: US midterm results a 'victory' for Canadians hopeful of tariff relief
articles.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford and other Canadian officials expressed relief following the Democratic sweep in the United States midterm elections on November 3, 2026, viewing the outcome as a rebuke of President Donald Trump's tariffs. While United States trade ministers noted short-term policies remain unchanged, experts suggest the political shift and voter frustration over rising prices provide Canada leverage to negotiate tariff-free trade deals.
articles.description: With Canada-US trade talks back on, Tuesday’s midterm Democratic wave puts pressure on the White House to come to a deal.

articles.headline: Democrats prepare for legislative challenges after winning control of Congress
articles.title: What Democrats can and can't do with their new power after taking Congress
articles.summary: Democrats secured control of both congressional chambers in the midterm elections, but face significant hurdles in enacting their agenda due to President Donald Trump’s veto power. While the party plans to investigate corruption and address healthcare costs, experts warn of potential legislative gridlock. Democrats remain divided on whether to pursue impeachment against the president.
articles.description: Democrats can vote legislation through. But Trump still has veto power.

articles.headline: US Justice Department sues Penn State over tuition policy for undocumented students
articles.title: US Justice Department sues Penn State over undocumented students’ tuition
articles.summary: The United States Department of Justice filed a lawsuit against Pennsylvania State University alleging that its in-state tuition policy for undocumented individuals violates federal law by excluding United States citizens. According to prosecutors, the practice constitutes unlawful preferential treatment. The university stated it is reviewing the complaint, which follows similar actions nationwide.
articles.description: The lawsuit challenges Penn State's policy that allows undocumented students to qualify for reduced tuition rates.

articles.headline: Russian attacks disrupt Kyiv power as village death toll reaches forty
articles.title: Russian attacks disrupt power in Kyiv, while death toll in a stricken village rises to 40
articles.summary: Russian strikes caused extensive power and water outages across Kyiv while President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reported the death toll in Komyshuvakha rose to forty. Attacks involving guided bombs targeted a former school and shelter in the Zaporizhzhia region on November second, two thousand twenty-six. Ukrainian air forces reported intercepting two hundred seventy-two drones amid ongoing regional conflict and international diplomatic meetings in Brussels.
articles.description: Russia attacked overnight with 310 drones, including 81 jet-powered drones, according to Ukraine’s air force. In its daily social media report, the air force said it downed or suppressed 272 drones of various types

articles.headline: India urges accountability for attacks against UN peacekeepers during debate
articles.title: Perpetrators of attacks against Blue Helmets must be held accountable: India at UN
articles.summary: Colonel Tarunendra Pratap Singh, Military Advisor at the Permanent Mission of India to the United Nations, addressed an annual debate on November 5, 2026, demanding accountability for assaults on Blue Helmets facing asymmetric threats. He emphasized that New Delhi has deployed over 300,000 troops across 50 missions and views peacekeeping as essential to global security operations.
articles.description: India is among the largest troop-contributing countries to UN peacekeeping, having deployed more than 3,00,000 troops across 50 missions to date

articles.headline: Netanyahu and Trump allies face political defeats after midterms and elections
articles.title: Netanyahu bet on Trump – but both lost
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump lost control of Congress and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu secured only fifty-three coalition seats following recent electoral contests. Analysts linked the setbacks to voter backlash against the joint United States and Israeli military campaign against Iran initiated in late February. The outcomes highlighted mounting political costs associated with Washington's military and diplomatic backing of Israel.
articles.description: Israel's political establishment grapples with US voter rejection of White House ally and own contribution towards it.

articles.headline: India secures 400 billion dollars in renewable energy investment commitments
articles.title: India secures $400-bn investment commitments in renewables; ALMM review in 15 days
articles.summary: Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy Pralhad Joshi announced on November 4, 2026, that India secured preliminary investment commitments worth 400 billion dollars for renewables. Speaking at the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo, Joshi also stated the government will consult industry stakeholders within 15 days regarding the potential extension of the domestic solar manufacturing framework known as ALMM.
articles.description: Pralhad Joshi, Union Minister for New and Renewable Energy told reporters that overseas investors have exuded confidence in India being a safe place for their investments.

articles.headline: Macau court sentences former lawmaker Au Kam San to prison for subversion
articles.title: China's Macau jails ex-lawmaker in first national security trial
articles.summary: A court in Macau sentenced 69-year-old former democracy campaigner Au Kam San to 12 years and six months in prison following a closed-door trial that concluded in September 2025. He was convicted of subversion and collaborating with external organizations, becoming the first person punished under national security laws expanded in the Chinese territory in 2023.
articles.description: Au Kam San, who co-organised annual vigils for victims of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown in Beijing, is the first person convicted under national security laws widened in 2023 in Macau

articles.headline: National Payments Corporation of India establishes technology subsidiary for digital infrastructure
articles.title: NPCI sets up tech subsidiary to tap AI, blockchain, and GCC opportunities
articles.summary: The National Payments Corporation of India created a wholly owned subsidiary named NPCI Tech Solutions Limited to advance capabilities in artificial intelligence, blockchain, and digital financial infrastructure. Vishal Kanvaty was appointed as the managing director and chief executive officer of the new entity, which received approval from the Reserve Bank of India.
articles.description: NPCI Tech Solutions will focus on artificial intelligence, blockchain and digital financial infrastructure, with Vishal Kanvaty appointed as its MD and CEO

articles.headline: UN commission report finds ongoing genocide and war crimes in Gaza
articles.title: United Nations report says genocide continues in Gaza
articles.summary: The Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory reported to the United Nations General Assembly on October 14, 2026, that Israeli authorities and forces continue to commit war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide in Gaza and the West Bank following the October 2025 ceasefire, citing thousands of deaths and systematic violations.
articles.description: The Israeli violations include widespread or systematic attacks directed against the civilian population, state policy, and the fact that the security forces knew the acts constituted part of an attack against the civilian population and so intended them (mens rea)

articles.headline: Vice President JD Vance blames Iran conflict for Republican midterm losses
articles.title: Presidential hopeful Vance appears to question Iran war after polls debacle
articles.summary: United States Vice President JD Vance attributed his party's midterm congressional defeat to the ongoing conflict with Iran. Writing on social media, Vance suggested the war was not worth losing Senate control to Democrats, diverging from President Donald Trump who expressed no regrets about launching the military campaign. Polling data indicated ending the conflict and altering relations with Israel were primary motivations for voters switching parties.
articles.description: US VP Vance cites trusted pollster saying Iran war, Israel ties were top of mind for Trump voters swinging to Democrats.

articles.headline: Andhra Pradesh increases airport and port health surveillance amid Ebola concerns
articles.title: Amid rising concerns over Ebola, A.P. steps up surveillance at airports
articles.summary: The health department in Andhra Pradesh enhanced passenger screening across three airports and three ports following a video conference with federal officials on November 5, 2026. Authorities prepared isolation beds, medical equipment, and response teams across five government facilities while scheduling a mock drill for November 12 to test readiness against the expanding outbreak.
articles.description: Medical teams stationed at three airports and three ports to screen passengers arriving from Ebola-affected countries for any symptoms

articles.headline: Donald Trump signs proclamation designating Oval Office as a national monument
articles.title: Trump issues proclamation declaring Oval Office national monument
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump signed a proclamation on Thursday declaring the Oval Office and Cabinet Room as a national monument to protect the spaces from future alterations. The executive action follows his party's defeat in the midterm elections and aims to preserve the architectural integrity of areas heavily redesigned during his second term.
articles.description: Following election losses, the signing marks Trump's third event of the week focused on signature renovation projects.

articles.headline: Supreme Court rejects plea for rotation of reserved parliamentary seats
articles.title: Supreme Court rejects plea for rotation of SC/ST-reserved seats in Parliament, Assemblies
articles.summary: The Supreme Court on November 4, 2026, refused to entertain a petition seeking mandatory rotation of constituencies reserved for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in Parliament and State Assemblies. A Bench led by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant stated that such policy decisions lie within the legislative domain of Parliament rather than the judiciary, upholding Section 9(1)(c) of the Delimitation Act, 2002.
articles.description: In a lighter vein, the CJI remarked that the petitioner could also take up the issue through public protests and demonstrations

articles.headline: Study finds cellophane bees produce flexible polyester that degrades in soil
articles.title: Cellophane bees produce a kind of plastic that also degrades, study finds
articles.summary: Researchers collecting translucent cell linings from ground-nesting cellophane bee nests in eastern Tennessee discovered that the material functions similarly to synthetic polyester. According to a study published in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, testing revealed that these nest linings undergo significant degradation within months in ambient soil.
articles.description: The nest lining of the ground-nesting bee is translucent, flexible, resilient and degrades within a year

articles.headline: Milky Way grew by consuming nearby galaxies and leaving stellar streams
articles.title: The Milky Way grew by devouring galaxies, leaving a trail of ghost stars
articles.summary: Galactic archaeologists studying stellar ages, chemical compositions, and motions discovered that the Milky Way expanded over nearly 12 billion years by devouring smaller galaxies like the Magellanic clouds. These violent collisions rip apart smaller galaxies, leaving behind distinct stellar streams that reveal the evolutionary history of our galaxy.
articles.description: Galactic archaeologists are using precise measures and larger sample sizes afforded by new missions to tease apart minute differences between groups of stars, revealing the history of the Milky Way going back almost 12 billion years

articles.headline: Democratic Socialist Nithya Raman wins LA mayoral race
articles.title: Democratic Socialist Nithya Raman wins LA mayoral race
articles.description: Nithya Raman's victory in LA marks the second major win for Democratic Socialists in a year.

articles.headline: Tanvi Patri wins silver medal at Youth Olympics in Dakar
articles.title: Tanvi Patri signs off with silver at Youth Olympics
articles.summary: Fifteen-year-old Tanvi Patri became the first Indian woman shuttler to secure an individual silver medal at the Youth Olympic Games on November 6, 2026. She lost a grueling three-game final against China's Zhang Yi Xin in Dakar. According to Badminton Association of India General Secretary Sanjay Mishra, the historic achievement reflects the immense potential of India's young sporting generation on the global stage.
articles.description: In a gripping summit clash that lasted an hour and 22 minutes, the 15-year-old Indian saved six match points and had three opportunities to seal the title

articles.headline: Building wind turbines out of parts found in Gaza’s rubble
articles.title: Building wind turbines out of parts found in Gaza’s rubble
articles.description: Palestinians in Gaza have made wind turbines to generate electricity, using scraps found in the rubble.

articles.headline: Ukrainian drone strikes kill three and damage power grid in Russia
articles.title: Ukrainian strikes kill three in Russia’s Belgorod region
articles.summary: Ukrainian drone strikes killed three people in Russia's Belgorod region and targeted critical energy infrastructure across multiple regions on Wednesday, according to officials. The attacks triggered extensive power and water outages in Kyiv and parts of Russian-occupied Crimea, while Russian forces responded with strikes on Ukrainian power generation facilities.
articles.description: Russian strikes also cut power to Ukrainian cities as Moscow claims 700 Ukrainian drones downed across multiple regions.

articles.headline: Israel President Herzog begins coalition consultations after undecided election results
articles.title: Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock
articles.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog started political consultations on Wednesday to select a candidate to form a new coalition government following the October 27 general election that produced no clear parliamentary majority. Central Elections Committee chairman Justice Noam Sohlberg delivered the official results in Jerusalem amid an ongoing Shin Bet investigation into foreign interference.
articles.description: Herzog warns politicians that "not every commitment and promise can be fulfilled" if they want to avoid another election.

articles.headline: Madhya Pradesh cabinet approves ₹63,296 crore greenfield corridors plan
articles.title: Madhya Pradesh cabinet approves ₹63,296 crore plan for five greenfield corridors
articles.summary: The Madhya Pradesh government approved a plan on November 6, 2026, to construct five greenfield expressway corridors spanning 1,398 kilometers across the state. The decision was finalized during a board meeting chaired by Chief Minister Dr. Mohan Yadav. Officials were directed to expedite ongoing road projects to ensure that no village or city remains deprived of all-weather connectivity.
articles.description: MP is developing a modern road network through the construction of state highways, four-lane, six-lane and eight-lane roads, as well as greenfield expressways: CM Mohan Yadav

articles.headline: Israeli President accepts certified election results amid fraud claims
articles.title: Israel’s President accepts certified election results in a blow to Netanyahu’s claim of vote fraud
articles.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog officially accepted the certified results of the recent parliamentary elections on November 4, 2026, dismissing unsubstantiated fraud claims made by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The election commission reported no evidence of irregularities affecting the vote outcome, where Netanyahu's bloc lost its majority. Herzog will now consult with party representatives to initiate the process of forming a new coalition government.
articles.description: Herzog's acceptance of the results as valid dealt a blow to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's effort to discredit the vote in which his religious-nationalist bloc lost its majority in the Israeli parliament, or Knesset

articles.headline: Kozo Tashima announces candidacy for the FIFA presidency
articles.title: Kozo Tashima: Japan leader looking to bring ‘integrity’ to FIFA
articles.summary: Kozo Tashima announced his bid to run against Gianni Infantino in the March FIFA presidential election. The 68-year-old former Japan Football Association president stated that his candidacy aims to uphold sporting integrity against commercial pressures. Tashima criticized recent decisions by football governing bodies and emphasized that the election tests FIFA ability to cleanse itself.
articles.description: The 68-year-old is set to become the first person from Japan to run for the FIFA presidency after announcing he would stand against Gianni Infantino

articles.headline: Democratic voters celebrate El-Sayed’s Michigan win in election ‘blue wave’
articles.title: Democratic voters celebrate El-Sayed’s Michigan win in election ‘blue wave’
articles.description: Democratic voters danced as they celebrated Abdul El-Sayed’s victory in Michigan.

articles.headline: US stock markets rise following Democratic sweep in midterm elections
articles.title: US markets rise as Democrats sweep midterm elections
articles.summary: United States stock markets advanced on Wednesday morning after Democrats secured control of both the House and Senate in the midterm elections. Major indices opened higher at 9:30 am Eastern Time, boosted by President Donald Trump accepting the results, while oil prices declined and artificial intelligence sector stocks experienced mixed reactions.
articles.description: Nasdaq, Dow, and S&P 500 open higher after Democrats take control and Trump accepts results.

articles.headline: New study finds noise pollution imposes fatal stress on wildlife
articles.title: A noisy Anthropocene is imposing fatal stress on wildlife
articles.summary: A new study published in Science on November 6, 2026, revealed that extreme noise pollution in the Anthropocene negatively impacts wildlife physiologically and behaviorally. Driven by traffic, industrial activity, and sonar operations, the rising din over the past fifty years affects more than one hundred aquatic and terrestrial species worldwide, according to the paper.
articles.description: Researchers analysed over 200 experimental studies on 177 aquatic and terrestrial species across six continents and found that noise altered specific traits in 80% of the animals studied

articles.headline: ABB India reports automation growth boosts workforce and hiring
articles.title: Automation has boosted employment, hiring of low-skilled workers in India, says ABB chief
articles.summary: Engineering firm ABB India has increased its workforce by 57% since 2021, reaching over 11,000 employees. CEO Sanjeev Sharma stated that automation allows the company to train lower-skilled workers for complex tasks using guided technology. The firm plans to invest $75 million through 2027, focusing on expanding operations into India's Tier-II and Tier-III cities.
articles.description: ABB India has committed to invest $75 million in India over 2026 and 2027 to fuel its organic expansion in the country, with a new focus on Tier-II and Tier-III cities

articles.headline: Temple priest denies ritual rights to women in Nizamabad district
articles.title: Diktats, boycotts and the fight for rights
articles.summary: During Sri Rama Navami celebrations, a temple priest allegedly ordered women from the Goud toddy-tapper community to leave a local Ramalayam in Tallarampur village. Kairi Kalyani and her neighbors had arrived with offerings to perform rituals but faced humiliation and exclusion based on their community background. The incident highlights ongoing discrimination and the difficult fight for social rights in rural areas.
articles.description: For over two years, 45 toddy-tapper and 10 Dalit families in Nizamabad’s Tallarampur have allegedly faced a complete social boycott for defying their Village Development Committee’s (VDC) orders. Denied access to groceries, medical aid and social gatherings, they have been pushed to the margins of everyday life. The growing clout of VDCs and nearly 90 complaints of alleged excesses before the Backward Classes Commission bring the larger issue into focus, as Ravi Reddy finds during a ground visit

articles.headline: Abdul El-Sayed wins US Senate seat in historic midterm election
articles.title: Abdul El-Sayed: The progressive’s progress
articles.summary: Abdul El-Sayed, a physician and epidemiologist, defeated Republican former Representative Mike Rogers with 52.5% of the vote to become the first Muslim member of the United States Senate. Published on November 4, 2026, the report notes this victory occurred during the midterm elections alongside Democratic wins in various regions, though analysts emphasized the unique significance of Dr. El-Sayed breaking long-standing political barriers.
articles.description: Abdul El-Sayed’s describes himself as ‘just a capitalist who understands how capitalism works’ and identifies as a progressive; his candidacy was backed by leading figures such as Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez

articles.headline: Iranian officials welcome US midterm losses as analysts warn of risks
articles.title: Iranian leaders welcome US midterm results, but Trump may still attack
articles.summary: Iranian authorities and state media celebrated the defeat of United States President Donald Trump's Republican Party in the congressional elections. Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, the Iranian parliament speaker, stated that Americans rejected war through the vote. Meanwhile, experts such as Sanam Vakil of Chatham House warned that the political shift might increase diplomatic pressure while keeping limited military strikes possible over the Strait of Hormuz.
articles.description: Tehran views midterm results as a rejection of Trump's 'war on Iran', signalling US frustration with foreign policy.

articles.headline: Trump faces reduced legislative power following Democratic congressional victories
articles.title: Is Trump really a ‘lame duck’ after losing both houses of US Congress?
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump is entering a divided government period after Democrats secured majorities in both houses of Congress during the midterm elections. While administration critics view the president as a lame duck with diminished influence over domestic legislation, political experts note that he retains significant executive authority and veto powers to pursue foreign policy and block opposition bills.
articles.description: Despite losing legislative control, the US president still has strong executive powers to push his agenda forward.

articles.headline: Supreme Court to hear Delhi voter roll exclusion case on November 19
articles.title: Delhi SIR: SC tells excluded voters not to fear prosecution even as ECI still insists on Form 6
articles.summary: Advocate Prashant Bhushan stated on November 4, 2026, that the Election Commission of India continued requiring excluded voters from Delhi's electoral rolls to complete Form 6 meant for new applicants. Petitioners Anjali Bhardwaj and Amrita Johri previously argued that forcing pre-existing voters to misrepresent themselves carries imprisonment risks. The Chief Justice of India assured that the Supreme Court is addressing the matter and scheduled the next hearing for November 19, 2026.
articles.description: On October 28, the Supreme Court made it clear that the ECI was in “error” to force pre-existing voters, deleted from the electoral rolls, to apply as new voters under Form 6 of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960

articles.headline: Union Cabinet extends Agniveer military service tenure by two years
articles.title: Agnipath scheme revised, 75% of Agniveers to get two-year extension
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a two-year extension for personnel serving under the Agnipath recruitment initiative, as announced by Chief of Defence Staff General N.S. Raja Subramani. Twenty-five percent of soldiers will continue to be absorbed into regular forces after four years, while remaining troops receive an additional engagement period before final selection evaluations. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh stated that the structural reforms aim to maintain a technologically equipped military.
articles.description: 25% of Agniveers will continue to be offered regular employment in the Defence Forces on merit, as originally envisaged under the Agnipath scheme, says General N. S. Raja Subramani

articles.headline: Four killed in gunfight between rival armed groups in Manipur
articles.title: Four killed in gunfight between rival armed groups in Manipur
articles.summary: At least four individuals died and several others sustained injuries during a violent clash involving rival armed factions in Manipur's Noney district on November 4, 2026. District officials reported that the exchange of fire began at around 3:30 a.m. in Taodaijang village. Meanwhile, a tribal organization extended a regional shutdown to protest a separate security failure involving the deaths of two youths.
articles.description: The pre-dawn incident, which is said to have involved three different groups, occurred in Noney district’s Taodaijang village

articles.headline: Donald Trump designates Oval Office as a national monument
articles.title: Trump designates Oval Office as national monument
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump signed an executive order on November 5, 2026, officially designating the Oval Office and Cabinet Room as national monuments to prevent future structural alterations. The announcement followed a difficult midterm election outcome for his Republican Party and drew criticism from opponents who argued the administration was ignoring pressing national concerns in favor of ongoing White House renovations.
articles.description: Critics accused Donald Trump of ignoring voter concerns over the Iran war and affordability ahead of midterm elections and obsessing instead on multiple construction and renovation projects in the capital

articles.headline: Keralam faces new challenges amid rising elderly population
articles.title: Solitary autumn years: Keralam to face new challenges with rise in elderly population
articles.summary: A domestic worker in Thiruvananthapuram named Sadia frequently travels to Tamil Nadu to care for her ailing elderly mother, spending half her salary on medical expenses while struggling with family property issues. This personal situation reflects broader socioeconomic challenges in Keralam regarding an increasing aging demographic. Published on November 6, 2026, the report highlights the growing strain on family support systems, unemployed siblings, and medical costs for elderly residents without adequate safety nets.
articles.description: Keralam’s elderly population is poised to go up significantly in a decade, which in turn, would bring up new challenges for the State in the elderly care. R.K. Roshni meets some of the elders and experts to understand the ground situation

articles.headline: James Talarico wins Texas Senate seat in historic midterm upset for Democrats
articles.title: James Talarico becomes first Democrat to win Texas Senate seat since 1988
articles.summary: Securing a major victory in Texas, Democrat James Talarico defeated Republican Ken Paxton in what marked the first time a Democrat won a US Senate seat in the state since 1988. The high-profile contest became the most expensive US Senate race in history, with substantial spending from outside groups. Talarico campaigned heavily on the rising cost of living under Republican leadership while facing an opponent backed by billionaire Elon Musk.
articles.description: "This wasn't just a tsunami, not just a referendum, but this was a bloodbath," one expert told the BBC on Democrats' historic wins in Texas.

articles.headline: White House denies departure rumours for Pete Hegseth and Marco Rubio
articles.title: White House denies Hegseth and Rubio to leave jobs after Republican election losses
articles.summary: The White House and the US State Department have rejected reports that Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth and Secretary of State Marco Rubio are leaving their posts following Republican midterm election losses. President Donald Trump expressed support for Hegseth despite criticism over the Iran war, while Rubio confirmed he plans to finish his term.
articles.description: US media reports there are calls to replace Pete Hegseth, who also faces a possible impeachment vote, while Marco Rubio is rumoured to be eyeing a presidential run.

articles.headline: Bhupender Yadav accuses Congress of spreading anarchy over electoral rolls
articles.title: Congress wants to spread anarchy in the name of democracy: Bhupender Yadav
articles.summary: Union Minister Bhupender Yadav criticized the Congress party and other opposition groups on November 5, 2026, for creating confusion regarding the special intensive revision of electoral rolls. Speaking in Patna, the Bharatiya Janata Party leader stated that the revision is a routine constitutional process managed by the Election Commission of India under Article 324.
articles.description: He added that instead of creating confusion over the special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, the opposition should present facts to the public

articles.headline: Democrats win control of US Congress as midterm elections yield historic results
articles.title: Everything you need to know from the US midterm elections
articles.summary: Securing majorities in both the Senate and House of Representatives during the midterm elections, Democrats took control of Congress for the remainder of President Donald Trump's term. Significant victories included Roy Cooper flipping a Senate seat in North Carolina and Keisha Lance Bottoms becoming Georgia's first Black female governor. Meanwhile, outgoing President Trump conceded that opposition candidates performed well and expressed willingness to work alongside them.
articles.description: Democrats secured some big wins - and a few historic firsts - earning congratulations from President Trump.

articles.headline: Gaza turns discarded cooking pots into seawalls
articles.title: Gaza turns discarded cooking pots into seawalls
articles.description: As winter approaches, Palestinians in Gaza are turning damaged cooking pots into makeshift seawalls to avoid flooding.

articles.headline: Truck collision on Karra-Torpa road kills seven people in Jharkhand
articles.title: Seven including three children killed after run over by truck in Khunti
articles.summary: Seven people, including three children and three women, were killed and one person was injured after being struck by an 18-wheel truck in the Khunti district of Jharkhand. Khunti Superintendent of Police Rishabh Garg stated that the incident occurred on November 5, 2026, on the Karra-Torpa main road within the Karra police station jurisdiction.
articles.description: The incident happened on the Karra-Torpa main road within the Karra police station limits on November 5, 2026 night

articles.headline: Republicans suffer major losses in United States midterm elections
articles.title: How big is the Republican midterms loss, and is there a silver lining?
articles.summary: The Republican Party experienced a severe defeat in the United States midterm elections, losing control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate to the Democratic Party. Democrats secured 228 seats in the lower chamber and 54 seats in the upper chamber, according to election results. Numerous candidates endorsed by President Donald Trump were defeated in key battleground states, though Republicans still maintained victories in several regional strongholds.
articles.description: The Republicans haven't been this weakened in Congress since 1990, but they did have some wins.

articles.headline: Pia Dandiya wins U.S. House seat from Florida
articles.title: Pia Dandiya, first-generation Indian-American, wins U.S. House of Representatives seat from Florida
articles.summary: Pia Dandiya secured a victory in the United States House of Representatives election for Florida’s 22nd congressional district on November 3, 2026. Defeating Republican opponent Casey Askar with 51.9 percent of the vote, the former high school principal and first-generation American flipped the competitive seat blue. Indian American Impact Executive Director Chintan Patel congratulated her on the historic win.
articles.description: Ms. Dandiya, a former high school principal, bagged 51.9% of the votes to become the newest Indian-American U.S. congresswoman, as per the results declared

articles.headline: Harmeet Kaur Dhillon resigns as United States Assistant Attorney General
articles.title: U.S. Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon resigns
articles.summary: Indian-American official Harmeet Kaur Dhillon stepped down from her role leading the Department of Justice Civil Rights Division following the mid-term elections. Attorney General Todd Blanche confirmed the departure on Thursday on social media. Dhillon stated she delayed her public announcement per White House chief of staff Susie Wiles to ensure the news followed the conclusion of voting.
articles.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche announced her resignation in a social media post, saying Assistant Attorney General Dhillon had "led the Civil Rights Division with conviction

articles.headline: West Bengal government discusses Ashok Leyland plant for Singur site
articles.title: Will do something for Singur, West Bengal CM signals fresh industrial push
articles.summary: West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced on November 5, 2026, that his administration is in discussions with Ashok Leyland to establish a vehicle manufacturing plant in Singur. Speaking during the unveiling of the state investment promotion policy, Adhikari outlined plans to purchase land directly through state funds without utilizing police force for acquisitions.
articles.description: Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari said that the government was in talks with Ashok Leyland for setting up a plant at Singur

articles.headline: Republicans blame Donald Trump for congressional losses in midterm elections
articles.title: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
articles.summary: Republican party members expressed intense frustration with United States President Donald Trump following midterm election losses on Tuesday, November 4, 2026. Critics argued that unpopular policies, economic concerns, and foreign conflicts cost the party control of Congress. While allies defended the president's efforts, the results have created uncertainty for the administration's agenda.
articles.description: Some Republicans tell the BBC the president's focus on his legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost them.

articles.headline: Gaza volunteer Adam Hamawy wins historic US Congress seat
articles.title: Gaza volunteer Adam Hamawy wins historic US Congress seat
articles.description: Egyptian-American surgeon Adam Hamawy has won New Jersey’s 12th Congressional District.

articles.headline: Union Minister J.P. Nadda sets March 2027 completion deadline for AIIMS Awantipora
articles.title: J&K’s health sector receives a shot in arm as Union Minister J.P. Nadda sets AIIMS deadline for March
articles.summary: Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda announced on November 5, 2026, that the All India Institute of Medical Sciences in Awantipora will be completed by March 2027. During a project review, Nadda directed officials to prioritize essential equipment procurement to facilitate outpatient department services and prepare for the commencement of MBBS classes in 2027.
articles.description: During a review of the phase-wise construction and handover plan, the Union Minister was informed that Phase-I buildings, including the OPD Registration Block, OPD Block, residential buildings and designated hostels, had been completed

articles.title: Jerusalem Daily: Mass arrests across occupied West Bank

articles.headline: Violence disrupts third phase of Rajasthan panchayat elections
articles.title: Violence mars third phase of Rajasthan panchayat elections
articles.summary: Clashes, stone-pelting, and allegations of bogus voting marred the third phase of panchayat elections across twenty-seven districts of Rajasthan on Thursday. Supporters of rival candidates fought in multiple districts, resulting in one death and several injuries in Jhunjhunu district. Police detained suspects and utilized a lathi charge to control crowds, while voting was cancelled at one village panchayat due to a missing candidate.

articles.headline: Iran responds to United States midterm election results and ongoing hostilities
articles.title: Iran’s Khamenei warns Trump loss at polls won’t end US hostility
articles.summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei warned that United States policy will not change following Democratic victories in the November 2026 midterm elections. While other officials expressed optimism about the vote and opposition to the war, Khamenei stated that resistance must continue. The remarks followed significant political setbacks for President Donald Trump.
articles.description: Iranian supreme leader says US policy won't change amid Tehran 'Fight Against Global Arrogance' day rallies

articles.headline: Union Cabinet approves viability gap funding scheme for energy storage
articles.title: Union Cabinet approves ₹14,500 crore VGF scheme to develop large scale energy storage in India
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet authorized a fourteen thousand five hundred crore rupee viability gap funding initiative to support grid-scale energy storage systems from 2026 to 2031. The program aims to facilitate ninety-two gigawatt-hours of fresh capacity through pumped storage and battery infrastructure. Officials stated that competitive bidding will determine project allocation while enforcing domestic manufacturing requirements for participating developers.
articles.description: The scheme is designed to provide for the development of hydro pumped storage plant (PSP) capacity, battery energy storage system (BESS) capacity, as well as alternative energy storage technologies

articles.headline: Kanchan Katkar crafts silver ornaments in Hupari for decades
articles.title: The silver hands of Hupari
articles.summary: Residing within the twisting lanes of Hupari town, seventy-six-year-old Kanchan Katkar meticulously attaches silver ghungroos to chain loops using iron tongs. Having completed school in 1970, she chose to remain single following the marriage of her sisters in order to care for her parents, who had actively participated in the Indian freedom struggle.
articles.description: In Maharashtra’s Hupari town, women artisans drive a ₹1,000-crore silver industry, sustaining a century-old trade. Radheshyam Jadhav reports on how, despite being underpaid and excluded from formal leadership, they forge their own economic autonomy in a deeply traditional landscape

articles.headline: Democratic congressional majority faces limitations on checking presidential authority
articles.title: Can Democrats stop Iran war, reverse Trump’s tariffs after midterms win?
articles.summary: Following midterm election victories on Tuesday, November 4, 2026, Democrats secured control of both chambers of Congress, empowering them to investigate the administration of United States President Donald Trump. However, analysts noted that legislative constraints will make it difficult to halt ongoing military actions or significantly reverse executive tariff policies before the next presidential term.
articles.description: Democrats can block Trump's legislative agenda, launch investigations but don't have the numbers to override his veto.

articles.title: Trump admits Iran war hurt Republican vote, vows to veto ‘insane’ bills

articles.headline: US midterm results could accelerate India trade talks
articles.title: U.S. midterm elections impact on India: Faster trade deal talks and higher tariffs likely
articles.summary: Following the Democratic victory in the United States midterm elections, experts predict that President Donald Trump may increase tariff pressure on India to secure a quick trade deal. According to Ajay Srivastava of the Global Trade Research Initiative, the administration will likely utilize executive powers to demand market access concessions, while Indian negotiators may push for more favorable terms.
articles.description: Trade and geopolitical experts say that losing control of the U.S. Congress will push President Donald Trump to increase tariff pressure on India to seal a deal. Indian negotiators, for their part, will smell an opportunity

articles.summary: Airbnb plans to launch an artificial intelligence agent in the first half of 2027 to assist users with trip planning and bookings, according to its third-quarter shareholder letter. articles.description: Airbnb plans to roll out an AI agent in the first half of 2027 that will help users plan and book travel, the company said in its Q3 2026 earnings shareholder letter released today. articles.headline: Pope Leo XIV begins Latin American tour following lung cancer surgery
articles.title: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV is embarking on a twelve-day tour of Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru just three weeks after undergoing surgery to remove a lung tumor. The Vatican stated that no extraordinary health measures are required for the seventy-one-year-old pontiff, whose itinerary features a homecoming to Peru where he previously served as a priest.
articles.description: Pope Leo, who had part of a lung removed last month, will visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru.

articles.headline: Kashmir faces ongoing terror threats despite drop in local militants
articles.title: Just one local terrorist active in Kashmir, but terror threat remains: IGP Sujit Kumar
articles.summary: Inspector General of Police Sujit Kumar reported that militancy in Kashmir has dropped to one active local terrorist, identified as Lateef Ahmad, alongside transitioning foreign operatives. Speaking on November 5, 2026, the official noted that security forces remain on alert while addressing additional regional challenges involving drug abuse, cybercrime, and traffic violations.
articles.description: The police identified Lateef Ahmad, 21, a resident of south Kashmir’s Kulgam, as the terrorist behind the Anantnag attack, which left one policeman dead in Anantnag’s Lal Chowk

articles.headline: Google faces slower search revenue growth amid AI expansion
articles.title: Google hasn’t figured out how to make AI pay like its search engine
articles.summary: Alphabet reported that while search queries are increasing rapidly, advertising revenue growth has decelerated as artificial intelligence interactions monetize at lower rates than traditional web searches. Advertisers remain uncertain regarding how automated conversational formats will ultimately perform compared to conventional shopping links. Executives noted that ongoing infrastructure investments are driving considerable capital expenditures across the parent company.
articles.description: Search queries are growing at their fastest rate in five years, Google parent Alphabet said in its earnings report last week. However, Google's Search revenue growth slowed to 12 percent year over year in the third quarter, down from roughly 17 percent in the previous quarter. Meanwhile, growth in paid clicks - clicks on ads […]

articles.headline: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan race to become first Muslim US senator
articles.title: ‘Call me senator’: How Abdul El-Sayed beat Trump’s hate to create history
articles.summary: Abdul El-Sayed secured a historic electoral victory in Michigan, defeating Republican opponent Mike Rogers to become the first Muslim member of the United States Senate. The progressive Democrat campaigned on addressing economic inequality, healthcare access, and living costs while criticizing foreign military interventions. The incoming senator previously served as executive director of the Detroit Health Department and holds degrees from the University of Michigan, Oxford, and Columbia University.
articles.description: The 42-year-old Democrat has defeated Republican Mike Rogers to become the first Muslim senator in the US.

articles.headline: Supreme Court upholds state power to levy sales tax
articles.title: Supreme Court upholds States’ power to levy additional sales tax, says case has become academic
articles.summary: The Supreme Court of India ruled on Wednesday that a 1974 Constitution Bench judgment upholding state power to impose additional sales tax or surcharges remains valid. A seven-judge bench headed by Chief Justice Surya Kant concluded that the long-standing legal reference had become academic because the challenged statutory provisions were replaced and the Goods and Services Tax was introduced.
articles.description: The seven-judge Bench, led by CJI Surya Kant, said the reference in the Orissa Sales Tax Act case no longer requires adjudication since the challenged provisions have been amended and GST governs the issue moving forward

articles.headline: Delhi implements winter action plan to combat seasonal air pollution
articles.title: Delhi's toxic winter air is back - is the Indian capital prepared for pollution?
articles.summary: The Delhi government has launched a Winter Action Plan to address the city's annual spike in toxic air pollution. The measures include construction bans and vehicle restrictions effective through February. While experts welcome the early planning, they warn that long-term success depends on stricter enforcement and regional cooperation to address diverse sources of harmful emissions.
articles.description: The Delhi government has announced a four-month winter action plan, but experts say that won't be enough.

articles.title: Why Democrats may struggle to rein in Trump’s foreign policy

articles.headline: Delhi Police defend ex-parte prohibitive orders in Supreme Court affidavit
articles.title: 60-day prohibitive orders passed ‘ex-parte’ to prevent unrest in key capital zones: Delhi Police in Supreme Court
articles.summary: Delhi Police Commissioner Anurag Kumar filed an affidavit in the Supreme Court detailing seven prohibitive orders issued under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita to restrict movement and public gatherings in key capital zones. The orders were enacted following July protests and prior to October demonstrations demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, which drew petitions challenging mass detentions and transport shutdowns.
articles.description: Six orders issued on August 20 or immediately before or after this date, came a month after the July 20 protests witnessed violence in New Delhi district; one of them imposes prohibitions from September 26 to November 24

articles.headline: Houthi siege on Taiz creates severe humanitarian crisis in Yemen
articles.title: Houthis’ monthlong siege on Taiz creating misery for trapped Yemenis
articles.summary: A monthlong blockade imposed by the Houthis on Taiz has severely disrupted food, fuel, and medical supplies for hundreds of thousands of residents. According to local officials, restricted access and dozens of checkpoints have escalated living costs, separated families, and prevented patients from seeking essential medical treatments outside the besieged southern Yemeni city.
articles.description: Blockade prompts warnings of a 'catastrophe' as food, water, fuel and medical supplies are unable to reach city.

articles.headline: Israel election commission certifies parliamentary vote results
articles.title: Israel vote results confirmed as election commission rejects fraud claims
articles.summary: Israel’s Central Elections Committee certified the parliamentary election results on Wednesday after reviewing 9,069 polling stations and finding no fraud. Supreme Court Justice Noam Sohlberg rejected Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's claims of vote rigging. The Netanyahu-led bloc won 53 seats, while opposition groups and Arab-led parties secured significant numbers, leaving no faction with the 61 seats needed to govern.
articles.description: Netanyahu’s allies refused to back the result, as President Herzog began talks on who should form the next government

articles.headline: Former US contractor pleads guilty to passing classified intelligence to Ethiopia
articles.title: US contractor gave Ethiopia secrets to help kill Tigray fighters
articles.summary: Abraham Teklu Lemma admitted to transmitting classified documents and photographs to senior officials during the 2020 civil war to assist in targeting fighters. The 54-year-old former contractor utilized his IT administrator role at agencies including the State Department to extract files between 2021 and August 2023. Facing up to 22 years in prison under a plea agreement, his sentencing is scheduled for April 14, 2027, according to the US Department of Justice.
articles.description: The Ethiopian-born American citizen admitted sharing dozens of classified documents with senior Ethiopian officials.

articles.headline: Perplexity launches new work-focused AI agents
articles.title: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence startup Perplexity has introduced always-on workspace agents called Teammates to compete with offerings from OpenAI and Anthropic. Operating continuously, these agents integrate with Perplexity Computer to handle concurrent large-scale tasks. The feature is available exclusively through the platform's two hundred dollars per month Max subscription plan, allowing users to monitor progress via dedicated application threads and Slack integrations.
articles.description: Perplexity is taking on OpenAI and Anthropic with its own work-focused AI agents. The startup's new always-on "Teammates" can take on multiple roles within a workspace, while pulling existing projects, skills, and memory from the Perplexity tools you already use. Teammates integrate with Perplexity Computer, an AI system that can deploy agents on your device […]

articles.headline: President Trump acknowledges Democratic midterm gains and accepts election results
articles.title: Trump takes aim at Republicans but says Democrats did a 'good job'
articles.summary: United States President Donald Trump conceded that Democrats performed well in the midterm elections after securing control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives. Speaking on November 4, 2026, Trump accepted the outcome and expressed willingness to work with Democrats, while warning that he would use his veto power against legislation he opposed and attributing some Republican losses to voter backlash over the conflict with Iran.
articles.description: He wrote on Truth Social that Republicans would have won "in a landslide" if his name had been on the ballot.

articles.headline: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Senate race to become first Muslim senator
articles.title: Left-wing Democrat Abdul El-Sayed wins in Michigan to become first Muslim senator
articles.summary: Left-wing Democrat Abdul El-Sayed defeated Republican Mike Rogers in Michigan on November 4, 2026, becoming the United States' first Muslim senator. The 42-year-old former public health administrator campaigned on a platform featuring universal health care and wealth taxes, overcoming an intense campaign marked by controversy, outside spending, and a late endorsement of his opponent by primary rival Haley Stevens.
articles.description: El-Sayed bested Republican Mike Rogers to become the first Muslim senator in US history.

articles.headline: Generation Z voters help redefine United States politics
articles.title: Generation Z and young voters help redefine US politics after midterms
articles.summary: The United States midterm elections marked a significant political shift as younger citizens voted overwhelmingly for the Democratic Party. Melat Kiros secured a historic victory in Colorado, becoming the first Generation Z woman elected to Congress. While voters under thirty represented a relatively small share of the total electorate, national polling indicated their strong dissatisfaction with current leadership and opposition to Donald Trump.
articles.description: Melat Kiros becomes the first Generation Z woman elected to Congress, embodying a new era of political representation.

articles.headline: South Africa ruling party faces sharp vote decline
articles.title: South Africa’s ANC on track for new lows in local polls
articles.summary: Early municipal election results in South Africa showed a sharply reduced vote share for the African National Congress, weakening the dominant party's control over major metropolitan areas like Johannesburg. Election commission data released on Thursday indicated voter turnout reached approximately fifty-four percent. Final outcomes, expected by Sunday, could trigger complex coalition negotiations across multiple city councils following widespread public frustration over municipal mismanagement.
articles.description: The ANC was on about 32 percent of the vote with more than 60 percent of votes counted in municipal elections.

articles.headline: West Bengal government announces investment policy promoting job-linked growth
articles.title: West Bengal govt’s new investment policy promotes job-linked growth, incentives for plant and machinery
articles.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party government in West Bengal unveiled a new investment promotion policy on November 5, 2026, offering incentives for plant and machinery investments and prioritising job creation. Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari stated the policy provides up to one hundred twenty percent assistance for thrust sectors and includes employer provident fund contribution reimbursements for women and transgender employees.
articles.description: The announcement of incentives marks a policy shift for West Bengal as the previous Trinamool Congress government had scrapped industrial incentive schemes and subsidies

articles.headline: Florida GOP redistricting strategy backfires in midterms
articles.title: GOP’s redistricting gamble backfires in Florida as Democrats hold ground
articles.summary: The Republican-led legislature in Florida saw its redrawn congressional map backfire as Democrats retained multiple seats during the midterm elections. Kathy Castor, Pia Dandiya, and Jared Moskowitz secured victories in districts that outgoing Governor Ron DeSantis and Republican lawmakers had reconfigured in April to favor the GOP, adding to broader Democratic gains nationwide.
articles.description: Trump's party dealt a setback as Republican bid to tilt Florida's House map falters on a strong night for Democrats.

articles.headline: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Senate seat to become first Muslim US senator
articles.title: ‘Rejecting hate’: Abdul El-Sayed wins Senate seat despite racist attacks
articles.summary: Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed defeated Republican Mike Rogers in Michigan on Tuesday to secure a United States Senate seat, overcoming anti-Muslim attacks led by President Donald Trump and setting a historic milestone. The victory helps Democrats regain control of the upper chamber. Voters in Detroit and neighboring Dearborn turned out in large numbers to reject bigotry, focusing instead on key issues like healthcare affordability, the economy, and ending foreign wars.
articles.description: The Democrat defeats Republican Mike Rogers to win Michigan seat to become first Muslim senator-elect in US history.

articles.summary: The United Nations Environment Programme released a report warning that global climate adaptation funding is falling far short of necessary requirements. The organization criticized wealthy nations for failing to fulfill financial pledges made at successive Conference of the Parties meetings to help developing countries build resilience against growing environmental costs and escalating economic crises linked directly to global carbon emissions.

articles.description: Republicans in Texas are trying to make sense of how they lost to the Democrats for the first time in almost 40 years.

articles.headline: Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri discusses Nepal Prime Minister's upcoming India visit
articles.title: Foreign Secretary Misri sets stage for Nepal PM’s upcoming India visit
articles.summary: Indian Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri met with Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah in Kathmandu on November 5, 2026, to prepare for the leader's upcoming visit to New Delhi. Discussions covered bilateral cooperation in hydropower, connectivity, and digital infrastructure. Both nations expressed gratitude for India's recent humanitarian assistance following the severe Bhotekoshi floods earlier this year.
articles.description: The Nepali leaders expressed “gratitude for India’s swift and substantial humanitarian and technical assistance in the aftermath of the Bhotekoshi floods”, a joint press release stated

articles.headline: Hakeem Jeffries poised to become first Black speaker of House
articles.title: Hakeem Jeffries poised to become first Black Speaker of U.S. House of Representatives
articles.summary: Democratic midterm victories have placed New York Representative Hakeem Jeffries in line to become the first Black speaker of the United States House of Representatives. Jeffries stated that his caucus would focus on affordability, protecting Medicaid, and investigating the administration of President Donald Trump. He faces the dual challenge of uniting moderate Democrats and progressive lawmakers while managing a divided government once the new Congress takes office in January.

articles.headline: Second Indian national dies from injuries sustained in Riyadh airport attack

The death brings the total fatality count to 14, following an earlier strike blamed on Yemen's Houthi rebels by Saudi authorities. The municipality estimated direct economic losses exceeded 12 million shekels daily during the siege.

articles.description: RJD MP Manoj Jha has moved the Supreme Court challenging Section 16 of The Chief Election Commissioner And Other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions Of Service And Term Of Office) Act, 2023

articles.headline: Democrat from Kansas elected to US Senate for first time since 1932
articles.title: Democrat from Kansas elected to US Senate for first time since 1932
articles.description: A Democrat from Kansas has been elected to the US Senate for the first time in 94 years.

articles.headline: European air travel disrupted by coordinated series of false bomb threats
articles.title: Who could be behind hoax bomb threats to European air travel?
articles.summary: Coordinated hoax bomb threats targeted multiple European airlines and airports, prompting flight diversions and fighter jet escorts in Italy. While analysts suspect possible hybrid warfare involvement by Russia amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, authorities stated that no definitive evidence has linked Moscow or any proxy groups to the incidents as of Thursday evening.
articles.description: There is no hard evidence so far linking airline bomb threats to Russia, Iran or any proxy groups.

articles.headline: Enforcement Directorate searches premises linked to housing society founder
articles.title: ED searches 12 premises linked to BLM society
articles.summary: The Enforcement Directorate conducted search operations on twelve premises linked to the Bharath Lajhna Multi State Housing Co-operative Society Limited and founder R. Premkumar across Kerala and Chennai on Wednesday. According to authorities, the investigation targets the alleged laundering of public funds amounting to approximately eighty crore rupees through numerous bank accounts controlled by the founder and his relatives.
articles.description: The searches were related to the alleged misappropriation and laundering of public funds belonging to Bharath Lajhna Multi State Housing Co-operative Society Ltd. by its founder

articles.headline: ‘We defeated Goliath’: Texas Democrat James Talarico wins Senate seat
articles.title: ‘We defeated Goliath’: Texas Democrat James Talarico wins Senate seat
articles.description: Democrat James Talarico wins the Texas Senate race in a historic midterm upset.

articles.headline: Trump-backed Vivek Ramaswamy loses Ohio gubernatorial race to Democrat Amy Acton
articles.title: Trump-backed Indian-American Vivek Ramaswamy loses Ohio Governor’s race
articles.summary: Republican candidate Vivek Ramaswamy was defeated in Ohio by Democrat Amy Acton, who secured over 51% of the vote to become the state's first female governor. Ramaswamy, endorsed by President Donald Trump after previously advising him on government efficiency, pumped over $36 million of personal loans into the campaign. The 41-year-old businessman conceded the race on November 4, 2026, expressing support for the incoming administration.
articles.description: Vivek Ramaswamy lost to Amy Acton, who became the first woman to be elected Governor of the state

articles.headline: Darline Graham loses South Carolina Senate race to Democrat
articles.title: South Carolina elects Democratic senator for first time in almost three decades
articles.summary: Republican candidate Darline Graham lost her United States Senate race, handing Democrats their first victory in South Carolina in 28 years. Former paediatrician Annie Andrews won the contest during midterm elections. Graham had been appointed in July following the death of her brother, Senator Lindsey Graham, and faced scrutiny during her campaign after admitting she lacked familiarity with national security matters.
articles.description: Annie Andrews is projected to defeat Darline Graham, who was handpicked by President Trump to take her brother's seat after his death.

articles.headline: Democrat Abdul el-Sayed wins United States Senate seat in Michigan
articles.title: Abdul El-Sayed defeats Mike Rogers to win US Senate seat in Michigan
articles.summary: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed defeated Republican Mike Rogers in the race for a United States Senate seat in Michigan, succeeding retiring Democratic Senator Gary Peters. The 42-year-old former Wayne County health director campaigned on progressive policies including Medicare for All and curbing corporate influence. Although the victory maintains the current Senate balance, his populist platform drew significant national attention and campaign spending.
articles.description: The Democrat prevailed after a stream of Islamophobic rhetoric from top Republicans and a turbulent end to his campaign.

articles.headline: Nigerian court invalidates opposition presidential candidate Atiku Abubakar's nomination
articles.title: Uncertainty over Nigeria vote as court bars opposition leader
articles.summary: A Nigerian federal high court invalidated the nomination of Atiku Abubakar, the presidential candidate for the African Democratic Congress, on November 5, 2026. The ruling stems from internal leadership disputes within the party. While the party plans to appeal, the decision creates significant uncertainty for voters ahead of the January 16, 2027, general elections.
articles.description: The ADC, one of the main opposition parties trying to oust President Bola Tinubu, has been mired in lawsuits around its leadership, which have now ensnared its 2027 nominee

articles.headline: Spanish transport minister resigns following deadly train crash in Castilla-La Mancha
articles.title: Spanish transport minister resigns after train crash killed 69 people
articles.summary: Spanish Transport Minister Oscar Puente resigned and withdrew from the upcoming general election following a high-speed train collision in central Spain that killed 69 people. The crash occurred when a Renfe state-owned train struck a stationary private Iryo train after controllers authorized travel despite a signal failure. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez announced a 30-million-euro aid package to compensate victims and bereaved families.
articles.description: Oscar Puente says he could not 'continue in office' after two major train accidents in less than a year.

articles.headline: Florida Republicans fend off Democratic challenges and elect Byron Donalds governor
articles.title: Florida Republicans fend off Democrats as state elects first black governor
articles.summary: Republican candidate Byron Donalds was projected to win the Florida gubernatorial election on Tuesday, replacing term-limited Governor Ron DeSantis. Fellow Republican Ashley Moody also successfully defended her Senate seat against Democrat Angie Nixon. The victories occurred despite broader historic Democratic gains that secured full control of the United States Congress.
articles.description: Republican Byron Donalds, who was backed by President Donald Trump, will be the first black governor of Florida.

articles.headline: Chris vs Chris: Who's running and what's at stake this New Zealand election
articles.title: Chris vs Chris: Who's running and what's at stake this New Zealand election
articles.description: New Zealanders will head to the polls on 7 November to elect a new government, with rising cost of living a key concern for voters.

articles.headline: Democrat Troy Jackson secures Maine Senate seat after defeating Susan Collins.
articles.title: Democrat Troy Jackson wins Maine US Senate seat in blow to Republicans
articles.summary: Democratic candidate Troy Jackson defeated longtime Republican incumbent Susan Collins to capture a United States Senate seat in Maine, ending a nearly thirty-year tenure. The highly contested race attracted heavy spending from outside groups. Collins conceded on Wednesday, marking a significant political shift in the northeastern state as voters weighed economic pressures and national political alignments.
articles.description: Longtime Republican Senator Susan Collins had held the seat for three decades, but was swept away in the blue wave.

articles.headline: Meta introduces real-time voice mode for Muse AI agent
articles.title: Muse has a voice mode now
articles.summary: Meta has launched a new voice mode for its Muse artificial intelligence agent, featuring expressive avatars that animate during conversations. CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced the update, which is currently rolling out to users in the United States on the iOS app. The feature will soon expand to Meta’s AI glasses and the upcoming Muse Charm hardware device.
articles.description: Meta now lets you have voice conversations with your Muse AI agent in real time, CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced today. The feature has been rolled out to me, and I gave it a spin on the iOS app while writing this article. As you chat with your Muse agent, the avatar at the top of […]

articles.headline: Telangana government plans Kaleshwaram project barrage restoration for December
articles.title: CM directs officials to begin Kaleshwaram barrage restoration works in December
articles.summary: Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy ordered officials to begin restoration work on the Medigadda, Annaram, and Sundilla barrages in December 2026. The project, estimated at 4,193 crore rupees, must follow National Dam Safety Authority guidelines. Construction agencies will cover defect rectification costs, while the state government will fund additional works to ensure structural integrity and safety.
articles.description: Final approvals to be secured by month-end; ₹4,193 crore estimated for repairs and restoration

articles.headline: Revenue Minister orders damage assessment following Cyclone Murasu in Khammam
articles.title: Revenue Minister orders assessment of cyclone damage on war-footing
articles.summary: Revenue Minister Ponguleti Srinivas Reddy directed officials to assess damage to crops, roads, and infrastructure caused by Cyclone Murasu in the Khammam and Bhadradri Kothagudem districts. Collectors must submit detailed reports within three days. The Minister praised the State Disaster Response Force for their rescue operations, which were supported by recent government equipment investments.

articles.headline: GTB Developers to build World Trade Center township in Chengalpattu
articles.title: World Trade Center township on the anvil for Chengalpattu
articles.summary: GTB Developers has received a license from the World Trade Centers Association to build an IT-integrated township in Chengalpattu. The 7,000 crore rupee project will span 100 to 150 acres and include office, residential, and hospitality spaces. Development is expected to occur in phases over ten years, with land acquisition currently in the advanced stages.
articles.description: The project has an estimated value of ₹7,000 crore and will be developed in phases over approximately ten years

articles.headline: South Africans head to polls for local elections amid declining ANC support.
articles.title: South Africans vote in local elections seen as test for embattled ANC
articles.summary: South African voters cast ballots in crucial municipal elections on Wednesday to choose councils across eight metropolitan areas, forty-four districts, and two hundred five local regions. The vote serves as a major test for the governing African National Congress following losses in recent national contests. Turnout and security remain key focal points as the nation anticipates coalition outcomes and final results by Sunday.
articles.description: Municipal failures have contributed to declining public trust, President Cyril Ramaphosa has admitted.

articles.headline: Senate Democrats express division over Chuck Schumer's leadership role
articles.title: Division among US Democrats over Schumer’s leadership role
articles.summary: Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer faces internal opposition as several incoming Democratic senators refuse to support his re-election. Critics cite concerns over his past political strategies and legislative effectiveness. While Schumer maintains confidence in securing a majority, progressive groups are calling for a contested leadership vote to define the party's future direction and agenda.
articles.description: Some Democratic senators – and the very voters that swept them into power – are demanding new leadership.

articles.headline: Democrats win majorities in US House and Senate in midterms
articles.title: Anthony Zurcher: Democrats push deep into Trump heartland on historic night
articles.summary: In the midterm elections, the Democratic Party captured majorities in both the United States House of Representatives and the Senate by flipping multiple seats across states like Texas, Kansas, and Maine. President Donald Trump, whose second-term approval ratings dropped, faced substantial losses as voters rejected his administration's policies. Despite Republican defeats, conservatives maintained control in a few areas, while newly elected Democratic majorities prepared to counter presidential legislative agendas.
articles.description: Two Senate races that a year ago were thought to be battlegrounds turned out to be slam-dunks for the Democrats.

articles.headline: Democrat Amy Acton makes history in Ohio
articles.title: Democrat Amy Acton makes history in Ohio
articles.description: Democrat Amy Acton defeats Republican Vivek Ramaswamy to become the first ever woman to be elected as governor in Ohio.

articles.headline: High Court to hear petition on corruption cases involving Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister
articles.title: HC to hear PIL on corruption cases involving Andhra CM Chandrababu Naidu on Nov. 10
articles.summary: The High Court will hear a public interest litigation on November 10 regarding corruption allegations against Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu. Petitioner K.B.G. Tilak seeks to transfer investigations to the Central Bureau of Investigation, fearing that the current government transition might impede existing probes into land acquisition, tender irregularities, and skill development centre projects.
articles.description: The PIL seeks transfer of the cases to the CBI; as the complainants are government officials, they have not come forward to challenge the closure reports for obvious reasons, argues the counsel for the petitioner

articles.headline: Supreme Court questions relevance of two-child norm amid declining fertility
articles.title: Supreme Court judgment questions two-child norm with falling fertility rate
articles.summary: On November 4, 2026, a Supreme Court bench headed by Justice P.S. Narasimha ruled that laws penalising families with more than two children have lost relevance due to India's total fertility rate dropping to 1.9. The Court noted that such demographic shifts could lead to an aging population and referred the legal question regarding election eligibility criteria to a larger bench, highlighting concerns over reproductive autonomy and political representation.
articles.description: The Court noted that India’s total fertility rate has fallen from 3 to 1.9. A total rate of 2.1, known as the replacement rate, would allow one generation to completely replace itself

articles.headline: Four killed and two missing after SUV plunges into river in Uttarakhand
articles.title: Four killed, two missing as SUV plunges into river near Gangotri
articles.summary: Four people died and two remain missing after an SUV carrying seven passengers fell into the Bhagirathi river near Gangnani on November 5. The vehicle was travelling to the Gangotri temple when it lost control on the highway. Rescue teams recovered four bodies, while one injured passenger was hospitalised. Authorities are currently investigating the accident.
articles.description: According to police, the accident took place on the Gangotri National Highway when the vehicle reportedly went out of control and plunged into the river
